summary: Unidentified medicinal plant (TLA: '[a (med.) plant]').

label: ḏꜣr.t (carob?)

summary: Unidentified medicinal plant.

label: ḫꜣs.yt-plant
summary: Unidentified medicinal plant whose fruit/seed is prescribed repeatedly in this section (bryony has been suggested).

label: prš (fir cone?)
summary: Possibly the cone of a fir (TLA: '[fir tree cone (?) (med.)]').

label: šꜣ.w (coriander)
summary: Coriander (Coriandrum sativum); its fruit/seed is a standard Ebers drug.

label: wꜥn (juniper)

label: ꜥš (fir)
summary: Fir/coniferous wood (Abies cilicica or similar).

summary: A kind of wheat (Triticum sp.); its flour is prescribed.

label: qst.t-plant
summary: Officinal plant of the pharmacopoeia; identity unresolved.

label: ꜥmꜥꜥ (grain kernel)
summary: Kernel of a cereal (barley or emmer) or a date pip; prescribed ground.

label: šnf.t-plant
summary: Unidentified plant or plant product.

label: tjḥwꜣ (peas)
summary: Peas (Pisum sp.?; TLA renders the German Erbsen).

label: ḫt-ds tree
summary: A tree-drug; the Leipzig English guesses myrtle with a query.

label: bnj.w (date juice)
summary: Juice or ferment of dates, a standard vehicle for ground drugs.

label: šꜣms-plant
summary: Unidentified medicinal plant (pyrethrum has been suggested).
